sentences.en: There are currently more open apprentice positions than applicants.
sentences.zh: 目前学徒职位的数量多于申请的人数。

sentences.en: When John was fourteen he was apprenticed to the trade of carpenter.
sentences.zh: 约翰十四岁时被安排到木匠行业当学徒。

sentences.en: It is normal and even desirable that the apprentice surpass the master.
sentences.zh: 徒弟超越师傅是正常的，甚至是可取的。
